chapters.label: The Black Spider
chapters.text: Wembley, 1963. England play the Rest of the World. In goal, all in black, is Lev Yashin, the Black Spider. Jimmy Greaves hits a rocket... but Yashin punches it all the way back to halfway!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Yashin doesn't wait on his line. He steps out and meets the ball with a boxer's punch!

chapters.label: Friends
chapters.text: Greaves can't believe it. The two stars fall into each other's arms, laughing!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Yashin shouted orders to his defenders. So shout loud, come for the ball with confidence. Your area is your home!
